purpose: Produce evidence-grounded job-application answer candidates and a reader-facing report through differentiated questions, protected quality gates, bounded revision, expert guidance, and measured publication validation.
expectedOutcome: A schema-valid report-only result containing complete candidate sets, attributable criterion evidence, qualified editing candidates, limitations, missing-material requests, interview preparation, and publication evidence without a submission claim.
intendedConsumers: career advisers reviewing candidate distinctions and interview defensibility
report-production agents operating under a bounded runtime request
owns: job-application report request and result contract
question differentiation and cross-question non-overlap invariant
application-report quality meaning and protected eligibility gates
bounded feedback edit and qualification reduction
reader-facing report projection and publication-validation handoff
mustNotOwn: company role applicant or project source truth
applicant identity values confirmation or final wording acceptance
cross-domain research context rubric review prompt or handoff semantics
renderer tool admission report submission publication or hiring decision
promotion integration or shared inventory ownership

inputs: native outputs of selected research context rubric review prompt and handoff Loops
interfaces.compatibility: Version 1 is report-only and additive. Schema, protected-gate, score-transform, role-boundary, privacy, or settlement changes require a new revision and fresh runtime validation.

reviewTriggers: protected criterion or score transformation changes
composed owner or role boundary changes
privacy publication or visible-content policy changes
repeated unsupported-claim score-reduction or user-correction findings
lifecycle.failure: Return exact schema, evidence, protected-gate, score, publication, privacy, or missing-context findings without repairing the frozen result or claiming acceptance.
lifecycle.recovery: Change the smallest invalidated request, evidence, candidate, profile, or publication artifact; perform only the remaining bounded revision and rerun deterministic and independent validation.
lifecycle.rollback: Remove the report-only package and its optional routing while preserving task-local chronology, extraction, and validation evidence; no runtime report migration is implied.
lifecycle.supersession: Bind a successor revision, compatibility statement, consumer migration, rollback evidence, independent review, and separate lifecycle decision.
lifecycle.retirement: Require no current consumers or a separately accepted replacement and preserve prior report-only evidence as historical observation.

limitations: The extraction is based on one completed application workflow and cannot establish cross-company or cross-role usefulness.
The material author also performed this deterministic validation; independent semantic review is unavailable.
The package coordinates report production but does not include a renderer, research provider, or external submission capability.
The shared reusable-artifact inventory has not been updated by its integration owner.
counterevidence: Accessibility conformance beyond searchable text remained unavailable in the observed completed report.
No repeat execution against a materially different application request has been observed.
